end.summary:
Named cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere with 4/5 unaided responses correct.
Matched everyday objects to 3D shapes with 2/3 unaided responses correct.
Recognised shapes in different positions and sizes with 2/2 unaided responses correct.
Used dice, matchbox, gas cylinder and football to explain shape features.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming the five 3D shapes, matching them with everyday objects, and noticing shapes when they turn or change size. Ishita used features such as equal cube faces, longer cuboid sides, circular cylinder ends, and a football being round all around. Ishita first mixed up a sphere and a circle, then corrected it by explaining that a circle is flat while a football is round from every side. At home, ask them to find one cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere and say one feature of each.
